current_state.zh: Alibaba's Qwen released Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo with open weights, cutting image generation denoising from 40 steps to 8 while retaining 2K output, text-guided editing and transparent-background support, with Turbo API pricing at 0.1 yuan per image under a non-commercial research license.
